stemMd: Which institution interprets EU law to help ensure its consistent application across member states?

options.label: B
options.textMd: The Court of Justice of the European Union

explanationMd: The Court of Justice of the European Union handles questions of EU law. Its role includes promoting consistent interpretation and application. It is distinct from both financial auditors and the European Court of Human Rights.

distractorRationale.c: Its work centres on monetary policy.
distractorRationale.e: This separate organisation is not the EU's court.
